newsitem.title: FRANCE: France slightly cuts winter grain sowings forecast.
newsitem.headline: France slightly cuts winter grain sowings forecast.

text.p: France's farm ministry, in its second estimate for sowings for the 1997 harvest, predicted total winter grain area would rise by 3.4 percent from last year to 6.630 million hectares.
In December the ministry had forecast sowings would rise 3.6 percent to 6.634 million hectares.
Winter soft wheat sowings were now forecast up 3.4 percent to 4.901 million hectares and winter barley sowings up 5.4 percent at 1.136 million hectares.
Winter durum wheat, which was 97 percent sown, was forecast down 0.9 percent to 261,000 hectares.
Oats were up 5.2 percent to 80,000 hectares. Rye was forecast down 1.6 percent to 48,000 hectares.
Hybrid triticale was down 0.1 percent to 204,000 hectares.
Overall winter grain sowings were 6.6 percent higher than the five-year average between 1991 and 1995.
